# Cheat sheet {.unnumbered}

Halaman ini merangkum sintaks yang paling sering dipakai. Setiap potongan ditulis dalam bahasa
Inggris, sama seperti seluruh buku, dan diuji di Nim 2.2.12.

## Deklarasi

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| nilai yang boleh berubah | `var count = 0` |
| diisi sekali | `let name = "Nim"` |
| diketahui saat kompilasi | `const MaxItems = 128` |
| tipe ditulis eksplisit | `var age: int8 = 24` |
| tanpa nilai awal, berisi default tipe | `var flag: bool` |

## Tipe dasar dan literal

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| bilangan bulat | `let n = 42` |
| bilangan pecahan | `let f = 3.14` |
| boolean | `let b = true` |
| karakter | `let c = 'x'` |
| teks | `let s = "text"` |
| tipe bulat berlebar | `int8`, `int16`, `int32`, `int64`, `int` |
| tipe pecahan | `float32`, `float64`, `float` |
| alias tipe | `type UserId = int` |
| heksadesimal, oktal, biner | `0xFF`, `0o17`, `0b1010` |
| pemisah digit | `1_000_000` |
| konversi | `int(3.9)`, `float(2)`, `$42` |

## String dan `&`

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| escape | `"line\n"`, `"tab\t"`, `"quote\""` |
| interpolasi | `&"{name} has {count}"` |
| gabung | `"a" & "b"` |
| indeks | `s[0]`, `s[^1]` |
| potong | `s[1 .. 3]`, `s[^3 .. ^1]` |
| satu karakter bertipe `char` | `s[0]` |
| panjang | `s.len` |

String mentah dan string multi-baris ditulis tanpa escape:

```nim
let raw = r"C:\temp"
let ml = """line one
line two"""
```

## `if`, `case`, `when`

```nim
let x = 3
if x > 0:
  echo "positive"
elif x == 0:
  echo "zero"
else:
  echo "negative"
```

```nim
case 0
of 0: echo "none"
of 1, 2: echo "few"
else: echo "many"
```

```nim
case 'a'
of 'a' .. 'z': echo "lower"
of '0' .. '9': echo "digit"
else: echo "other"
```

```nim
when defined(windows):
  echo "windows"
else:
  echo "other"
```

## Perulangan

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| rentang inklusif | `for i in 0 .. 3:` |
| rentang eksklusif | `for i in 0 ..< 3:` |
| dengan langkah | `for i in countup(0, 10, 2):` |
| mundur | `for i in countdown(5, 1):` |
| elemen saja | `for value in items:` |
| indeks dan elemen | `for i, v in items:` |
| selama | `while n > 0:` |
| hentikan, lanjut | `break`, `continue` |

## `array`, `seq`, dan `openArray`

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| larik ukuran tetap | `var a: array[3, int] = [1, 2, 3]` |
| larik tanpa tipe eksplisit | `let a = [1, 2, 3]` |
| barisan | `let s = @[1, 2, 3]` |
| barisan kosong bertipe | `var s: seq[int] = @[]` |
| tambah, buang | `s.add 4`, `s.delete(0)` |
| sisip | `s.insert(1, 0)` |
| panjang | `s.len` |
| potong | `s[0 .. ^2]` |
| parameter fleksibel | `proc total(xs: openArray[int]): int` |

## Tuple dan destructuring

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| tipe bernama | `type Point = tuple[x, y: int]` |
| nilai | `let p: Point = (x: 1, y: 2)` |
| akses field | `p.x` |
| akses posisi | `p[0]` |
| bongkar jadi variabel | `let (a, b) = (1, 2)` |

## Object dan `ref object`

```nim
type
  Person = object
    name: string
    age: int

let p = Person(name: "Ada", age: 36)
echo p.name
```

```nim
type Node = ref object
  value: int
  next: Node

var n: Node
new(n)
n.value = 1
echo n.value
```

## Enum dan set

```nim
type Color = enum
  red, green, blue

echo ord(green)

var flags: set[Color] = {red, blue}
flags.incl green
flags.excl red
echo green in flags
```

## Prosedur dan parameter

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| nilai balik | `proc add(a, b: int): int = a + b` |
| tanpa efek samping | `func square(x: int): int = x * x` |
| parameter default | `proc greet(name: string, punctuation = "!")` |
| argumen bernama | `greet(punctuation = "?")` |
| overloading | `proc show(x: int)` dan `proc show(x: string)` |
| parameter `var` | `proc double(x: var int) = x = x * 2` |

## Generic

```nim
proc largest[T](items: openArray[T]): T =
  result = items[0]
  for item in items:
    if item > result:
      result = item

echo largest([3, 9, 4])
```

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| tipe generic | `type Box[T] = object` |
| batasan tipe | `proc double[T: SomeNumber](x: T): T` |

## Template

```nim
template twice(body: untyped) =
  body
  body

twice:
  echo "ping"
```

## Macro

```nim
import std/macros

macro triple(x: untyped): untyped =
  result = quote do:
    `x` * 3

echo triple(4)
```

## Exception dan `raises`

```nim
try:
  raise newException(ValueError, "bad")
except ValueError as e:
  echo e.msg
finally:
  echo "done"
```

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| pengecualian sendiri | `type TooLarge = object of CatchableError` |
| melempar | `raise newException(TooLarge, "too large")` |
| efek `raises` | `proc risky(): int {.raises: [ValueError].}` |
| bersihkan saat keluar | `defer: echo "cleanup"` |

## Iterator

```nim
iterator evens(n: int): int =
  for i in 0 .. n:
    if i mod 2 == 0:
      yield i

for e in evens(6):
  echo e
```

## `import` dan `export`

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| impor modul | `import std/strutils` |
| beberapa sekaligus | `import std/[strutils, sequtils]` |
| impor sebagian | `from std/math import sqrt` |
| alias | `import std/strutils as str` |
| pakai kualifikasi | `str.strip(s)` |
| ekspor ulang | `export mymodule` |

## `strutils`, `sequtils`, `tables`, `json`

```nim
import std/[strutils, sequtils, tables, json]

echo "  Ada  ".strip.split(' ')
echo @[1, 2, 3].filterIt(it > 1).mapIt(it * 2)

var ages = initTable[string, int]()
ages["ada"] = 36
echo ages.getOrDefault("linus", 0)

let doc = """{"city": "Bandung"}""".parseJson
echo doc["city"].getStr
```

| Modul | Fungsi sering dipakai |
|---|---|
| `strutils` | `strip`, `split`, `join`, `toUpperAscii`, `startsWith`, `replace`, `parseInt` |
| `sequtils` | `mapIt`, `filterIt`, `foldl` |
| `tables` | `initTable`, `hasKey`, `getOrDefault`, `t["k"]` |
| `json` | `parseJson`, `%*`, `getStr`, `getInt`, `pretty`, `to(Tipe)` |

## `os`

| Konsep | Kode |
|---|---|
| variabel lingkungan | `getEnv("HOME", "/")`, `existsEnv("HOME")` |
| argumen program | `paramCount()`, `paramStr(1)`, `commandLineParams()` |
| direktori | `getCurrentDir()`, `setCurrentDir(dir)` |
| uji berkas | `fileExists(p)`, `dirExists(p)` |
| gabung jalur | `"dir" / "file.txt"` |
| baca, tulis | `readFile(p)`, `writeFile(p, s)` |
| telusuri | `walkDir(dir)`, `walkFiles("*.txt")` |

## `unittest`

```nim
import std/unittest

suite "add":
  test "two plus two":
    check 2 + 2 == 4
```

```nim
import std/[unittest, strutils]

expect ValueError:
  discard parseInt("x")
```

## `async`

```nim
import std/asyncdispatch

proc fetch(n: int): Future[int] {.async.} =
  return n * 2

proc main() {.async.} =
  let a = await fetch(3)
  let b = await fetch(4)
  echo a + b

waitFor main()
```

## FFI

```nim
{.compile: "helper.c".}

proc twice(x: cint): cint {.importc.}

echo twice(4)
```

```c
int twice(int x) { return x * 2; }
```

## Perintah `nim` dan `nimble`

| Perintah | Arti |
|---|---|
| `nim c file.nim` | kompilasi |
| `nim r file.nim` | kompilasi lalu jalankan |
| `nim check file.nim` | periksa tipe saja |
| `nim c -d:release file.nim` | build teroptimasi |
| `nim c -o:app file.nim` | tentukan nama biner |
| `nim c --mm:orc file.nim` | pilih mode memori |
| `nim js file.nim` | kompilasi ke JavaScript |
| `nim doc file.nim` | buat dokumentasi |
| `nim c --hints:off file.nim` | senyapkan hint |
| `nimble test` | jalankan tes |
| `nimble add pkg` | tambah dependensi |
| `nimble init` | buat perancah proyek |
| `nimble build` | bangun proyek |
| `nimble run` | bangun lalu jalankan |
| `nimble install nama` | pasang paket |

Isi halaman ini diuji di Nim 2.2.12. Untuk penjelasan lebih panjang, setiap bagian punya babnya
sendiri di buku ini.
